quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap reflecting Nordnet's capital-light pan-Nordic digital savings and pension infrastructure (tangible ROIC 120.3%, operating margin ~65%, SEK 4.68B cash vs SEK 188M debt). Peak Owner EPS of SEK 11.82 is supported by SEK 1.5T in customer savings capital. Forward compound growth of 8.5% (g_implied) is driven by pan-Nordic savings volume (6.5%), pension fee mix (1.0%), and operating leverage (1.0%), offset by NII normalization (-0.5%) plus capital returns.
